verdicts.reason: A reads left to right in a sensible order (brand, big two-line headline, details column, can, CTA cluster). But the RSVP button is no bigger than the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the CTA competes with them, the broken image placeholder overlaps the URL text, and the copy in the middle column is small and cramped. B breaks up the layout: the time/venue line is stranded on the far left away from its date, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is tiny and cut off from the headline and logo, RSVP is buried as just another pill in the row with a squeezed 'FREEENTRY', the URL sits top right away from the CTA, and the logo is jammed into the corner against the decorative circle.
